h:
这是一个简单的工作流程，从视频中获取每一帧，将其传递给 img2img（带有 loras 和可选的自动字幕），然后将它们重新组合成一个新视频。

这是我第一次发布的工作流程，所以请随意发表评论/批评/帮助:D

o.en:
This is a simple workflow that takes each frame from a video, passes it through img2img (with loras and optional autocaption), then recombines them into a new video.

This is my first published workflow, so feel free to comment/criticize/help :D
